text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #111111

g.text: BCE may independently suppress a confusable wrong-class score (e.g., kamyun ↔ kamyunet),

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #6f6f6f

g.text: but this mechanism was not directly tested in these runs.

g.text: BCE is slightly better in both architectures, but the gain is small and metric-dependent.

g.text: Same seed, split, optimizer, learning rate, augmentation, and training budget; ~770 validation images per run.

g.text: Note: Validation loss is omitted from the comparison because CE and BCE have different scales. All reported gains are single-seed results.
